description: Adds one entry to a field worker's (staff_id) staff log and their attendance and feedback counts: kind warning (a conduct warning), kudos, note, client_feedback (with sentiment), or sick, late, no_show. A sick day, late arrival or no-show that cancelled or moved a visit is recorded by cancelling or reassigning that booking with the cleaner's reason instead, so do not record those twice. occurredOn is YYYY-MM-DD (default today); body is the detail in plain words. Nothing is sent to the worker. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: record_staff_event
title: Record a warning, kudos or note for a field worker
